source.method: Text of every review copied from the published page (WordPress REST content of page 1714, identical to the live HTML). Wording, punctuation and attributions are unchanged; formatting (bold, italics, colors) and the images were not kept.

notes.order: position = order on the published page (1 = first shown). The page lists reviews from the highest number down.
notes.numbering: number/label = the number exactly as published. The published numbering is not a clean sequence; it has not been corrected.
notes.images: The published page also showed 463 small images (461 distinct URLs) hotlinked from Google Docs (lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com). They were not captured; their content is unknown and they are not reproduced.
notes.attributionFields: name, city and state are split from the published attribution line; "attribution" is the exact published line. Two attributions have no comma before the state.
